slot_tip.title: Potion Slot
slot_tip.description: Use potions during combat to gain bonuses or hinder enemies.

potion_slots.name: Skill Potion
potion_slots.description: Choose 1 of 3 random Skill cards to add into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.

potion_slots.name: Fairy in a Bottle
potion_slots.description: When your HP would be reduced to 0, instead this potion is discarded and you heal to 30% of your Max HP.
